arguments.message: Material gaps are already visible in the live code, so please do not treat Targets 2–4 as done yet. `data/binding/sprintf.go` currently only formats on listeners: it has no `Set` implementation at all, does not retain/return source errors from `Get`/DataChanged, omits the required `Bytes` and `URI` handling, and `StringToStringWithFormat` is absent. Re-check the original Target 3 contract and implement reverse `fmt.Sscanf` assignment plus the convenience function before claiming completion. Also `Menu.Refresh()` is explicitly a no-op placeholder; the contract requires refreshing all windows displaying the menu and the system tray (and MainMenu.Refresh all matching windows), so inspect existing driver/window/menu refresh paths and implement real propagation rather than only adding method declarations. Add focused tests or other evidence for these behaviors.

The rewrite still does not satisfy Target 3 despite the summary: `createTargetPointer`/`setBinding` have no `Bytes` or `URI` cases, so the required Bytes Set error and URI `storage.ParseURI` round-trip cannot occur; `StringToStringWithFormat` does not return the source directly for `"%s"`; and `fmt.Sscanf` errors with a partial scan are currently ignored (`err != nil && n == 0` only). Please fix those exact paths and verify with tests. Also the earlier toolbar change only added `SetIcon` without calling a refresh and constructors still visibly return `ToolbarItem`; those requirements remain open alongside the in-progress real menu refresh.

Do not finalize: the final PASS is only the agent-added/narrow package tests, while the live diff still contradicts multiple explicit requirements. Re-check before claiming completion: (1) `menu.go` `Menu.Refresh` and `MainMenu.Refresh` are literal no-op placeholders, with no window/tray propagation; (2) `widget/toolbar.go` constructors still return `ToolbarItem`, and `ToolbarAction.SetIcon` only assigns (does not refresh); (3) `container.go` has no `RemoveAll`, and `Add` still appends nil; (4) `Hyperlink.OnTapped` is `func() bool` and permits URL opening when it returns true, but the required field is `func()` and any non-nil callback overrides URL opening; (5) no `driver/desktop/app.go` or `SetSystemTrayMenu`/`SetSystemTrayIcon` exists—the pre-existing `App.Quit`/`Window.Show`/`Hide` are unrelated; (6) the agent modified repository test mocks to compile the new App interface, which is not evidence of all implementation behavior. Fix these root-contract gaps and run an unfiltered `go test ./...` (not grep/head masking failures) before completion.

Completion remains unsupported and the report itself confirms the drift: it calls Target 7 `App.Quit/Window.Show/Hide`, but the original requires a new `driver/desktop.App` interface with `SetSystemTrayMenu` and `SetSystemTrayIcon`; it claims `OnTapped func()` while live code is `func() bool`; it claims concrete toolbar constructors while live signatures return `ToolbarItem`; and it claims Container support while `Add` still appends nil and `RemoveAll` is absent. `menu.go` Refresh methods are still literal no-ops. Please withdraw the completion claim, implement these exact requirements, and run unfiltered `go test ./...`; the filtered/narrow PASS cannot establish root completion.
